coverageAssessment.claimedScope: No city-specific open parcel scope verified in this research pass. Country-level evidence is not attributed to this urban centre.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No target-area sheet returned/intersected in the bounded selector/sheet checks.
coverageAssessment.finding: An official Nandail Upazila Land Office confirms local land-administration/registry capacity. Separately, the live DLRS selector chain found Mymensingh district BDS/RS survey 201901 but its GetThanaListBySurveyMap result was empty, so no Nandail mouza/sheet was available in that active survey selector. No parcel geometry was verified; this is not proof of absent cadastral records or other survey editions.

nextStep: The active Mymensingh survey chain returned no upazila entries. Check other survey editions / selector codes for Mymensingh district and recheck whether Nandail appears; request a single sheet only after the exact target mouza is exposed.
